evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies REST endpoint handler in src/rest.cpp.
rationale: Prevents spurious `[error]` log entries that mimic disk corruption when requesting spent TXOs for pruned or side-branch blocks. An unauthenticated endpoint was invoking `ReadBlockUndo()` on blocks without undo data, spamming `debug.log` despite properly returning a 404.
